interface.longDescription: Project Design currently provides the implemented Project Canvas business methodology. Eight other installed entries are explicit placeholders for future global orchestration, functional and technical design, traceable backlog preparation, and four discipline-specific document generators. No document-generation methodology or external format integration is implemented.
